scope.interpretation: Artiverse is a fixed reference dataset. This arm measures whether prompt-only CLIP retrieval can find an existing reference asset satisfying the constraints; it is not Artiverse generation and must not be placed in the same-prompt generation ranking.

benchmark.prompt_policy: Use the exact complete English prompt string in each JSONL row. Do not rewrite, summarize, add category labels, or use spec files.

dataset.full_data_gate: All 3544 manifest-listed model roots must exist as regular in-workspace directories and the depth-three model-root set must equal the manifest set. Both archive byte sizes and SHA-256 values must match before formal selection. A partial extraction is not evaluable.

candidate_eligibility.rule: A candidate is eligible iff imgs is a regular directory containing exactly the 16 required regular non-symlink PNG files, no other PNG files, and every required image can be fully decoded by Pillow then converted to RGB. Eligibility never depends on category, GLB/URDF availability, geometry, dimensions, part names, articulations, metadata, or downstream scores.
candidate_eligibility.ineligible_policy: Exclude before embedding and report the fixed reason. Do not repair renders or replace them.

retriever.preprocess: Pinned CLIPProcessor: resize shortest edge to 224 with bicubic resampling, center crop 224x224, RGB conversion, CLIP mean [0.48145466,0.4578275,0.40821073], CLIP std [0.26862954,0.26130258,0.27577711].
retriever.text_tokenization: Pinned CLIP tokenizer with padding=true, truncation=true, max_length=77; exact full prompt is supplied before deterministic tokenizer truncation.
retriever.view_aggregation: Extract one 512-D float32 image feature per view. Convert to float64 and L2-normalize each view independently. Take the equal-weight arithmetic mean of the 16 normalized view features and L2-normalize that mean in float64.
retriever.text_feature: Extract one 512-D float32 text feature per exact prompt, convert to float64, and L2-normalize in float64.
retriever.score: Float64 dot product between the normalized prompt feature and normalized 16-view aggregate feature.
retriever.selection: Global top-1 over every eligible asset; no category filter.
retriever.tie_break: Sort by descending exact float64 score, then ascending SHA-256(identity path), then ascending identity path. No epsilon tie window.
retriever.determinism: eval and inference_mode; random seeds 0; CUDA TF32 disabled; cuDNN benchmark disabled; deterministic algorithms enabled; no test-time augmentation.

selection_must_not_read: any Table 4 scorer, evaluator, canonicalizer, or previous method output
segmented GLB or any other geometry
URDF, articulation JSON, material JSON, mass JSON, or part/node names
asset category as a feature or filter
dimensions, constraint measurements, or output scores
anti_leakage.phase_boundary: Selection writes a SHA-256-locked 18-row selection manifest. Only after that lock exists may materialization open the selected segmented GLB files.

materialization.selected_source: Within each locked selected root, require exactly one regular non-symlink file matching *.segmented.glb.
materialization.failure_policy: Any missing, ambiguous, unreadable, or non-canonicalizable selected GLB is a task failure. Never fall back to rank 2 or choose another asset. Never rescale to a target.

primary_for_this_supplement: numeric constraint pass over 20 frozen numeric constraints
reporting.supplementary_only: The existing exact-count scorer is a name-matched renderable-node proxy and is not semantic exact-count ground truth for Artiverse GLB node names.
reporting.required_label: Artiverse prompt-only CLIP retrieval (dataset reference; not generation)
reporting.not_allowed: Do not merge this result into the same-prompt generation headline or describe selected assets as generated by Artiverse.

category_identity_reference_supplement.selection_rule_if_enabled: Use only the frozen category mapping below, then select the ascending minimum SHA-256(identity path) within the mapped Artiverse category. No prompt embeddings, geometry, dimensions, part names, or score-dependent fallback.
